  • Create engaging and creative content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and other digital platforms.
  • Develop ideas and concepts for Reels, videos, social media posts, campaigns, and promotional content.
  • Write engaging captions, scripts, hooks, and short‑form content.
  • Collaborate with the Digital Marketing, Graphic Design, and Video Editing teams.

  • Participate in content shoots and assist in planning creative concepts.

  • Maintain consistency in brand voice, messaging, and visual storytelling.

  • Strong creative thinking and storytelling skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Knowledge of social media platforms and current content trends.
  • Ability to write engaging captions and short‑form scripts.
